how: Chrome for Testing 157.0.8103.78 headless (SwiftShader WebGL 2) driven over CDP by ~/workspace/makefun/tools/shot.mjs; game served locally from game/ on :8080; each URL loaded with ?shot=<mode>&seed=1; the game runs its own deterministic staged scene, renders twice, sets window.__shotReady, and the driver captures a JPEG. No pixels were edited after capture.
